content_sections.heading: About Goa Samagra Shiksha
content_sections.text: Goa Samagra Shiksha works from the 1st Floor of the Directorate of Education at Porvorim, Goa, under its State Project Director. This recruitment fills instructor vacancies in Government and Aided High Schools and Higher Secondary Schools across the NSQF sectors.

content_sections.heading: Walk-in Interview Schedule
content_sections.text: Page 7 of the notice says candidates must register at the office before 11:00 AM for the morning slot and before 3:30 PM for the afternoon slot. Page 1 separately gives the interview time as 10.00 am and the reporting time as 9.45 am.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through the walk-in interview, during which original certificates and documents are verified. A candidate who fails to produce the required original and valid documents when called upon shall be eliminated. A shortlisted candidate's candidature shall be rejected at any time if he or she is found ineligible when essential documents are verified.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely on a contract basis until the end of the Academic Year 2026-27. The vacancies are in Government and Aided High Schools and Higher Secondary Schools. The post is transferrable anywhere in Goa.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Goa Samagra Shiksha Instructor Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare an application addressed to the State Project Director, Goa Samagra Shiksha, Secondary Education, Directorate of Education, Porvorim. If you want more than one sector, prepare a separate application for each. Go to the Directorate of Education, Porvorim, Goa, on the date and in the slot fixed for your sector. Submit the application with the necessary documents on the day of the interview. Give one set of copies of your certificates to the interview panel. Documents to bring in original: Passing certificates of educational qualifications and mark sheets Passport size photograph Age proof, including Birth Certificate Address proof Valid residence certificate for 15 years Valid employment registration certificate issued by the competent authorities (Employment Exchange Card) Certificates for achievement in sports and other extra-curricular activities, if any

faq.question: Q1. Which sector has the most Instructor posts?
faq.answer: Tourism & Hospitality has the most, with 08 posts. Telecommunication and Plumbing have the fewest, with 01 post each.

faq.question: Q2. Can a 12th pass candidate apply?
faq.answer: Yes, in the Retail sector, if the candidate has 04 years of sector specific experience in Retail Store Operations or Sales.

faq.question: Q3. Can I attend for more than one sector?
faq.answer: Yes, but a separate application must be submitted for each sector. Check the schedule first, because each sector has its own date and slot.

faq.question: Q4. Is Konkani compulsory for this job?
faq.answer: Yes, knowledge of Konkani is essential, while Marathi is only desirable.

faq.question: Q5. Which residence document is needed?
faq.answer: Candidates need a valid residence certificate for 15 years, along with a valid employment registration certificate issued by the competent authorities.

faq.question: Q6. Where will selected Instructors work?
faq.answer: They will work in Government or Aided High Schools and Higher Secondary Schools, and can be transferred anywhere in Goa.

faq.question: Q7. How long does the contract last?
faq.answer: The contract runs until the end of the Academic Year 2026-27, which the notice gives as 31 March 2027.

faq.question: Q8. Is travelling allowance paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, travelling allowance is not admissible for candidates attending the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. Can the recruitment be cancelled?
faq.answer: Yes, the authority reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process at any time without any prior notice.
